plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETFs.

conservative.read: This mode aims for ~1.5% monthly growth with a focus on capital preservation. Risk is minimized through reduced leverage and concentration, but upside potential is also capped.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.

This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This mode targets ~2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It reduces leverage and concentration while blending broad market exposure with quality additions.

plan: Increase SOXL and SPAL to leverage upside potential.
Trim SPY to reduce concentration and reallocate capital.

aggressive.read: This mode targets ~4% monthly growth, accepting higher potential drawdowns. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrated high-conviction names, requiring strict stop discipline due to amplified risk and ETF decay.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, and CRWD to exit leveraged and high-beta positions.
Increase QQQI to maximize focus on income generation.
Trim SPY and QQQ to reduce broad index exposure.
Buy COP as a stable income-generating asset.

income.read: This mode targets ~1% monthly growth through stable income distributions. It minimizes risk by cutting leverage and high-beta assets, focusing on income-generating ETFs and stable holdings, though NAV can still decline in market selloffs.
